mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT(LPAD(h, 2, '0'), ':00-', LPAD(h + 1, 2, '0'), ':00') AS time_slot, cnt AS count FROM ( SELECT HOUR(time) AS h, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM reservation WHERE DATE(time) = #{time} AND status != 2 GROUP BY HOUR(time) ) t ORDER BY h
SELECT id, name, mobile, time, visitor, type, status, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, remark FROM reservation WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE reservation SET status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE reservation SET status = 3 WHERE time < NOW() AND status = 0
UPDATE reservation SET status = 3 WHERE id = #{reservationId} AND status = 0
